content.value: The configuration of a furnace can be approximated as an equilateral triangular duct which is sufficiently long that the end effects are negligible. The hot wall is maintained at $T _ { 1 } = 9 0 0 K$ and has emissivity $\varepsilon _ { 1 } = 0 . 8$ . The cold is maintained at $T _ { 2 } = 4 0 0 K$ and has emissivity $\varepsilon _ { 2 } = 0 . 8$ . the third wall is reradiating zone, $\dot { q } _ { 3 } = 0$ The accompanying sketch illustrates the configuration. Calculate the neat radiation heat flux leaving the hot wall.
